kebab_example: aliyun vs set-vs-streams-notify-url-config --domain-name example.com --notify-url http://xxx.com/xx --auth-type type_a --auth-key ocs00000ace --region cn-hangzhou
name: SetVsStreamsNotifyUrlConfig

parameters.description_en:
The URL to which live stream information is pushed.

> This URL must start with http\:// or https\://.
parameters.description_zh:
设置直播流信息推送到的URL地址。
> 必须以 http:// 或者 https:// 开头。

parameters.description_en:
The authentication type. Valid values:

- **no\_auth** (disabled)

- **type\_a** (method A)

- **type\_b** (method B)

- **type\_c** (method C)

- **no_auth**（关闭）
- **type_a**（A方式）
- **type_b**（B方式）
- **type_c**（C方式）

parameters.description_en:
The primary key associated with the playback domain name. This key generates authenticated URLs.

> Call the [DescribeVsDomainConfigs](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/464513.html) operation to query the AuthKey value.
